name: Ghost Fingers (Su)
body:
Benefit(s): A ninja with this talent can use her ki to quickly and accurately disable mechanical traps and locks. She may use this power one of three ways.

She may roll two dice while making a Disable Device check and take the better result.

She may make a Disable Device check without the appropriate tools and suffer no penalty for doing so.

She may make a Disable Device check as a move action, regardless of how long it would normally take.
A ninja must choose to use this trick before making a Disable Device check. Each use of this ability uses up 1 ki point.
